svg.aria-label: Warp Classes Used by fdars Registration
svg.title: Warp Classes Used by fdars Registration
svg.desc: Four panels plot the registering warp h(t) against t on [0, 1] with the identity dashed: shift warps t minus delta are parallel lines clamped at the boundary; affine warps a t plus b change slope and intercept; a landmark warp is a monotone Fritsch–Carlson cubic through marked knots; an elastic warp is any increasing diffeomorphism, with the dynamic-programming slope limits 1/7 and 7 drawn as a cone. Shift is contained in affine, which is contained in the warp group; landmark and continuous warps also lie in the group.
svg.text: Warp Classes Used by fdars Registration
Registering warp h(t) on [0, 1]; registered curve x̃(t) = x(h(t)); identity dashed
Nested only loosely: shift ⊂ affine ⊂ Γ; landmark and continuous warps also lie in Γ
